name: Qiansui International Group Co. Ltd.
summary: Qiansui International Group Co. Ltd. does not have significant operations. It intends to acquire or merge with an operating business. Previously, the company was involved in the provision of contract electronics manufacturing services. The company was formerly known as Z Holdings Group, Inc. and changed its name to Qiansui International Group Co. Ltd. in August 2015. Qiansui International Group Co. Ltd. is based in New York, New York. Qiansui International Group Co. Ltd. is a subsidiary of SeaMorri Financial Partners, LLC.
